question: A newly hired Agentforce Specialist at Universal Containers asks which tools make up Agentforce Studio so she can plan the team's build-test-monitor lifecycle. What is the correct composition?
options: Agentforce Builder + Testing Center + Observability.
Prompt Builder + Model Builder + Flow Builder.
Legacy Agent Builder + Data Cloud + Trust Layer.
explanation: Agentforce Studio centraliza el ciclo de vida de los agentes mediante Agentforce Builder para construcción, Testing Center para pruebas, y Observability para el monitoreo. No incluye herramientas externas de otras nubes en su composición base.

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) is deploying a new customer service agent using Agent Script. The Agentforce Specialist needs to update conversational state, navigate between different subagent (formerly known as a topic), and hand off conversations to a human agent when necessary. To minimize technical debt, the Agentforce Specialist wants to implement these capabilities without building any custom backend code. Which statement correctly describes how the Agentforce Specialist can implement these specific requirements?
options: The Agentforce Specialist can use @utils.setVariables, @utils.transition, and @utils.escalate directly.
The Agentforce Specialist can use most utilities directly, but @utils.escalate requires a custom Apex class to define the escalation queue.
The Agentforce Specialist can use most utilities out of the box, but @utils.transition requires a flow to define the target subagent at runtime.
explanation: Agent Script posee utilidades nativas como @utils.setVariables y @utils.transition, permitiendo manejar el estado y la escalación sin código Apex.

question: Universal Containers wants to utilize Einstein for Sales to help sales reps reach their sales quotas by providing Al-generated plans containing guidance and steps for closing deals. Which feature should the AI Specialist recommend to the sales team?
options: Find Similar Deals
Create Account Plan
Create Close Plan
explanation: Create Close Plan genera planes con orientación y pasos específicos para cerrar oportunidades de ventas.

question: Which statement explains why a company might prefer a hybrid search index in Data Cloud for Agentforce?
options: Vector embeddings in hybrid search are prefiltered by keyword matches, reducing computational overhead and improving response accuracy.
Hybrid search indexes process queries faster than vector search because they eliminate the need for semantic embedding.
Hybrid search indexes support both literal keyword matches and semantic recall, useful when queries mix specific terms and intent.
explanation: La búsqueda híbrida combina la precisión exacta de las palabras clave con la comprensión semántica de los vectores. Es ideal cuando las consultas incluyen tanto lenguaje natural como identificadores específicos.

question: A company wants to retrieve patient history details to augment the AI agent response. The company wants to leverage the Data Cloud search index feature. What is best practice when considering retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for information that may contain personally identifiable information (PII)?
options: Mask sensitive fields and index only non-PII dat
Depend on the agent's prompt to avoid exposing PII.
Encrypt embeddings, but still index PII records.
explanation: La información confidencial (PII) debe enmascararse o excluirse antes de generar los vectores y el índice en Data Cloud. Esto asegura que los datos sensibles no lleguen al modelo ni al contexto de recuperación.

question: Universal Containers (UC) has registered an external service and created a template-triggered prompt flow that invokes the external service to fetch data from a REST API. UC now needs to make the response data from the external service usable inside a prompt template as a merge field when the template runs. How should UC meet this requirement?
options: Use External Service Record merge fields.
Convert the JSON to an XML merge field.
Use the 'Add Prompt Instructions' flow element.
explanation: Los datos recuperados vía REST API se almacenan como registros de servicios externos. Se pueden referenciar dinámicamente en las plantillas usando campos de combinación de estos registros.

question: An e-commerce company needs to ensure that discount application actions are only available to customers whose membership status is "Premium" or "Elite." This restriction must be enforced programmatically without AI interpretation. How should the specialist implement this deterministic control?
options: Establish a context variable mapped to membership status and apply conditional filters requiring qualifying status on all discount actions.
Include detailed instructions in the topic description.
Create a validation rule on the order object that blocks discount application after submission.
explanation: Establecer una variable de contexto y filtros condicionales asegura que la acción solo esté disponible cuando se cumpla la condición. Este enfoque garantiza un control programático sin depender de la IA.

question: A sales manager is using Agent Assistant to streamline their daily tasks. They ask the agent to "Show me a list of my open opportunities." How does the large language model (LLM) in Agentforce identify and execute the action to show the sales manager a list of open opportunities?
options: The LLM interprets the user's request, generates a plan by identifying the appropriate topics and actions, and executes the actions to retrieve and display the open opportunities.
Using a dialog pattern, the LLM matches the user query to the available topic, action and steps then performs the steps for each action.
The LLM uses a static set of rules to match the user's request with predefined topics and actions.
explanation: El LLM interpreta la petición, genera un plan identificando los topics y actions adecuados, y los ejecuta.

question: Universal Containers’ current AI data masking rules do not align with organizational privacy and security policies and requirements. What should an AI Specialist recommend to resolve the issue?
options: Enable data masking for sandbox refreshes.
Configure data masking in the Einstein Trust Layer setup.
Add new data masking rules in LLM setup.
explanation: Las reglas de enmascaramiento de datos de IA se configuran en el setup del Einstein Trust Layer.

question: Before activating a custom Agentforce action, an AI Specialist would like to understand multiple real-world user utterances to ensure the action is being selected appropriately. Which tool should the AI Specialist recommend?
options: Model Playground
Agentforce
Agentforce Builder
explanation: Agentforce Builder es la herramienta ideal para evaluar múltiples expresiones reales de usuarios y asegurar que las acciones se seleccionen correctamente.

question: Coastline Credit Union needs a weekly dashboard for its leadership team showing agent deflection and escalation trends over time, without building custom reports from scratch. Which native Agentforce Observability capability should the specialist point them to?
options: Agent Analytics, which provides prebuilt, Tableau-powered dashboards covering deflection, abandonment, escalations, and volume trends.
The raw Session Tracing Data Model objects, queried manually via SOQL each week.
Testing Center pass/fail results, exported to a spreadsheet weekly.
explanation: Agent Analytics proporciona paneles preconstruidos impulsados por Tableau que muestran tendencias de desvío, abandono y escalamiento. Es la solución nativa ideal para reportes ejecutivos.

question: Safe Haven Animal Shelter is creating a prompt template to help agents write responses to adopters whose new pets have health issues. They want the replies to sound caring, clear, and practical. What is a key element to include in the prompt template?
options: A directive such as "You are a caring, clear, and practical pet adoption support specialist."
A bulleted list of keywords like "vaccination," "appetite," "lethargy," and "vet."
The pet's complete medical history including all previous treatments.
explanation: Instruir directamente sobre el rol o persona (ej. 'eres un especialista empático') es la mejor forma de moldear el tono del LLM. Es ligero y muy efectivo en comunicaciones sensibles.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is implementing Einstein Generative AI to improve customer insights and interactions. UC needs audit and feedback data to be accessible for reporting purposes. What is a consideration for this requirement?
options: Storing this data requires Data Cloud to be provisioned.
Storing this data requires a custom object for data to be configured.
Storing this data requires Salesforce big objects.
explanation: Data Cloud permite almacenar y unificar datos de auditoría y retroalimentación a gran escala, siendo ideal para interacciones basadas en IA. Los objetos estándar o Big Objects no ofrecen la capacidad de procesamiento y segmentación requerida.

question: Universal Containers grounds its agent with three search indexes (manuals, policies, past cases) and the prompt template is becoming hard to maintain with three separate retrievers. Results also need a single relevance ranking. What should the Agentforce Specialist configure in Einstein Studio?
options: An Ensemble Retriever, which ranks the combined results of multiple retrievers and lets the prompt template reference fewer individual retrievers.
Three additional individual retrievers with stricter filters on each index.
A single search index merging the three data sources into one DMO.
explanation: Un Retriever de Conjunto (Ensemble Retriever) en Einstein Studio unifica y recalcula la relevancia de los resultados procedentes de múltiples índices de búsqueda. Esto simplifica la gestión del prompt template al agrupar la información.

question: Which scenario best illustrates the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) in an enterprise AI deployment?
options: A legal assistant agent using MCP to dynamically find a document classification API to analyze case files
A customer service agent engaging another agent in real-time conversation to resolve tickets
A sales agent discovering other agents' capabilities using Agent Cards
explanation: MCP se utiliza principalmente para que un agente descubra y se conecte a herramientas y APIs externas, como una de clasificación de documentos. La colaboración entre agentes corresponde al protocolo A2A.

question: An Agentforce Specialist wants to troubleshoot their Agent's performance. Which tool should they use to review agent execution details?
options: Event Logs.
Platform Debug Logs.
Agent Analytics dashboard.
explanation: Los Event Logs proporcionan información detallada sobre la ejecución e interacciones del agente, siendo la herramienta indicada para diagnosticar su rendimiento.

question: When a search index is created in Data Cloud, what component is automatically generated to enable querying?
options: A default retriever sharing the name of the search index.
A dynamic query builder with configurable runtime parameters.
A custom Apex class for programmatic retrieval.
explanation: Al crear un índice de búsqueda en Data Cloud, se genera automáticamente un retriever predeterminado con el mismo nombre para habilitar las consultas. Esto facilita la recuperación de datos sin configuraciones adicionales complejas.

question: Universal Containers implements three custom actions to get three distinct types of sales summaries for its users. Users are complaining that they are not getting the right summary based on their utterances. What should the Agentforce Specialist investigate as the root cause?
options: Review the Action Instructions to ensure they are unique.
Review that the custom action is assigned to an Agent.
Ensure the input and output types are correctly chosen.
explanation: Revise Action Instructions para asegurar que las acciones sean únicas y desambiguar resultados.

question: An Agentforce Specialist is working declaratively on version 4 of a prompt template which is significantly different from the previous version 3. A bug is then identified in version 3 and requires a hotfix to be deployed to production immediately by another team. The team will deploy this change as a new version. What should the specialist do to ensure that their work on the latest version is not lost and does not conflict with the new version?
options: Create a new prompt template with the bug fix, update all references to the new version, and delete the old prompt template.
Save their work in version 4, and allow the template to be deployed with a new version 5 containing the fix.
Copy and paste version 4 into a backup file or version-control alternative, and allow the other team to overwrite the contents of version 4 with the bug-fixed version.
explanation: Prompt Builder guarda versiones de manera aditiva, por lo que el progreso en una versión no impide que otros equipos implementen correcciones en versiones nuevas.

question: The AI Specialist of Northern Trail Outfitters reviewed the organization's data masking settings within the Configure Data Masking menu within Setup. Upon assessing all of the fields, a few additional fields were deemed sensitive and have been masked within Einstein's Trust Layer. Which steps should the AI Specialist take upon modifying the masked fields?
options: Turn off the Einstein Trust Layer and turn it on again.
Test and confirm that the responses generated from prompts that utilize the data and masked data do not adversely affect the quality of the generated response
Turn on Einstein Feedback so that end users can report if there are any negative side effects on AI features.
explanation: Es fundamental probar los prompts tras modificar datos enmascarados para asegurar la calidad de las respuestas. Reiniciar la capa de confianza no valida el impacto del enmascaramiento.

question: When configuring a custom action for an AI assistant, why are action instructions critically important?
options: They provide end users with guidance on how to phrase requests.
They define the expected user experience and conversation flow.
They direct the language model on which action to select based on the conversation context.
explanation: Las instrucciones de acción son fundamentales porque indican al modelo de lenguaje qué acción seleccionar en función del contexto de la conversación. No están destinadas a guiar al usuario final ni a definir la experiencia del usuario.

question: A specialist tests an agent connected to a data library. The agent retrieves the correct information but presents it as raw XML markup instead of natural, grammatically correct sentences. Which quality evaluation metric would score poorly in this scenario?
options: Coherence
Completeness
Conciseness
explanation: La coherencia mide si la respuesta fluye naturalmente con una estructura y gramática lógicas; una salida de texto en bruto fallaría estrepitosamente aquí.

question: A manufacturer wants their AI agent to answer questions about equipment specifications using technical documentation stored in Data Cloud. Results must be filtered by equipment category and prioritized by most recent revision date. What implementation approach should the specialist use?
options: Keyword search with category matching rules.
Standard semantic search with default metadata filtering.
Create a custom retriever with category filters and recency ranking to provide precise control over both filtering and prioritization.
explanation: Un 'custom retriever' permite aplicar tanto filtros precisos (categorías) como lógicas de priorización (fecha de revisión) a los resultados de búsqueda.

question: A financial services firm has built an AI agent using a low-code orchestration tool. The agent has a "Process Investment Withdrawal" action. According to company policy, withdrawals are allowed only if the client's Risk Profile is "Aggressive." Currently, the agent relies on its base instructions to check this field, but it sometimes hallucinates authorization and tries to execute the withdrawal for "Conservative" clients, causing transaction errors. How can the specialist enforce a deterministic control that prevents the agent from even seeing the withdrawal action unless the client meets the eligibility rule?
options: Add a conditional availability rule directly on the "Process Investment Withdrawal" action so that the action is hidden from the agent unless Risk_Profile__c = "Aggressive".
Rewrite the agent's system instructions to include a strict warning: "Never call withdrawal for Conservative clients" and hope the language model follows it.
Configure a keyword filter that automatically blocks the words "withdrawal" or "redeem" from appearing in the user's message if the client is not Aggressive.
explanation: Agregar una regla de disponibilidad condicional directamente en la acción garantiza de forma determinista que solo usuarios elegibles puedan ejecutarla.

question: Northwind Logistics observes that its agent often misroutes "freight damage" claims to the "delivery delay" subagent. The manager needs to identify how frequently this happens across thousands of daily conversations without reading each transcript. Which tool should they use?
options: Agent Optimization in Agentforce Studio, which automatically clusters user intents from production sessions and highlights subagent mismatches.
Enable Session Tracing and manually search for keywords like "damage" in the logs.
Run a batch test in Testing Center with sample damage claims to see classification results.
explanation: Agent Optimization agrupa intenciones y analiza sesiones en producción para identificar patrones de enrutamiento incorrecto a gran escala. Es la herramienta ideal para monitoreo continuo, superando la búsqueda manual.

question: At Precision Manufacturing, newly hired sales representatives struggle with handling technical objections and pricing negotiations for complex industrial equipment. The sales director cannot personally coach each rep before their client meetings. The reps need a tool that allows them to practice their sales conversations through realistic simulations and receive tailored feedback specific to the opportunities they're pursuing. Which Salesforce solution should the implementation specialist recommend?
options: Sales Readiness Coach (Sales Coach), designed for role-play simulations tailored to specific opportunities.
Account Executive Agent (SDR Agent), designed for lead qualification/outreach, not coaching.
"Opportunity Simulator" — not a standard Salesforce product.
explanation: Agentforce Sales Coach ofrece simulaciones de juego de roles adaptadas a oportunidades específicas. Permite a los representantes practicar conversaciones y recibir comentarios personalizados de la IA.

question: Universal Containers has seen a high adoption rate of a new feature that uses generative AI to populate a summary field of a custom object, Competitor Analysis. All sales users have the same profile but one user cannot see the generative AlI-enabled field icon next to the summary field. What is the most likely cause of the issue?
options: The user does not have the Prompt Template User permission set assigned.
The prompt template associated with summary field is not activated for that user.
The user does not have the field Generative AI User permission set assigned.
explanation: El usuario debe tener asignado el conjunto de permisos de Generative AI User para acceder a las capacidades de IA generativa. Sin este permiso, no podrá ver el campo habilitado.

question: After launching a new support assistant on their customer portal, a company receives feedback that the assistant cannot answer questions that are clearly addressed in their knowledge base articles. What is the most probable cause?
options: The assistant user was not assigned the correct license type.
The assistant user lacks the permission set that grants access to view and retrieve knowledge articles.
The knowledge articles were not included in the deployment package.
explanation: Si el usuario del asistente no tiene el conjunto de permisos para ver y recuperar artículos de conocimiento, no podrá consultarlos. El acceso a los datos de la base de conocimientos debe concederse explícitamente.

question: A development team needs to create a prompt template that can be invoked from a custom Visualforce page. Which prompt template type should they select?
options: Universal templates.
External Call templates.
Flex templates, general-purpose and invokable from external contexts including custom code.
explanation: Las plantillas 'Flex' son de propósito general y pueden invocarse desde contextos externos como código Apex, Visualforce o componentes Lightning.

question: Mountain Peak Resorts is indexing hundreds of HTML documents containing detailed property descriptions, amenity lists, and local attraction information for their new resort properties. They need the assistant to retrieve accurate information quickly while maintaining contextual relationships within the documents. What indexing strategy should they apply to preserve document structure and improve retrieval accuracy?
options: Semantic passage extraction, identifying conceptually complete paragraphs regardless of document structure.
Section-aware chunking that splits documents based on natural headings and logical divisions to preserve contextual integrity.
Fixed-size chunking, uniform segments regardless of structure.
explanation: El 'section-aware chunking' divide los documentos basándose en encabezados lógicos, preservando la integridad contextual en documentos estructurados como HTML.

question: CloudTech Solutions is developing a custom prompt template to auto-populate a field using AI-generated content. CloudTech has enabled Einstein Trust Layer monitoring to track AI usage and identify improvement opportunities. Which prompt template type and configuration requirement should CloudTech use?
options: Field Generation template with Dynamic Forms enabled on the target object.
Record Summary template with "Dynamic Layouts" enabled.
Field Generation template with "Flexible Page Layouts" enabled.
explanation: Una plantilla de Field Generation junto con Dynamic Forms es la combinación correcta para poblar un campo específico con contenido de IA. Esta configuración permite aplicar sugerencias directamente en el registro.

question: A real estate investment firm is creating a prompt template for an agent that needs to reference property inspection records related to an account. The specialist wants to include fields from the Inspections__r related list on the Account object. What is the correct procedure in Prompt Builder?
options: Select the Inspections related list from the Account object, then use the field picker to choose specific merge fields from that list to include in the prompt.
Write an Apex method that queries the inspection records and returns JSON, then reference that method in the prompt.
Hard-code the inspection field names as literal text in the prompt and rely on the LLM to infer the relationship.
explanation: Prompt Builder permite agregar declarativamente listas relacionadas como Inspecciones y seleccionar campos de combinación sin tener que escribir código Apex.

question: A bank's service agent can access sensitive account transaction data only after the customer completes voice biometric verification. The specialist needs a deterministic control that prevents the LLM from bypassing verification to run the "Show Transactions" action. What should they configure?
options: Apply an availability filter (available when) on the "Show Transactions" action so it is hidden from the planner until a verification variable becomes true.
Add a system instruction that says "Never show transactions without verification" and place it in every subagent.
Store the transaction data in an encrypted field and only decrypt it after the LLM requests verification.
explanation: Un filtro `available when` oculta completamente la acción al planificador hasta que se cumpla la condición. Esto garantiza de forma determinista que no se ejecute sin la verificación previa.

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) has been building an agent using Canvas. It has created an "Issue Refund" action. Business rules dictate that refunds can only be issued if the customer's Account_Tier is "Platinum". Currently, the agent relies on its system instructions to check the tier, but it occasionally hallucinates authorization and attempts to call the refund action for Standard customers, resulting in backend errors. How should the Agentforce Specialist use filters to deterministically ensure the agent cannot process the "Issue Refund" action unless the customer meets the criteria?
options: Configure an Action Condition filter so the "Issue Refund" action is only available when the Account_Tier variable equals "Platinum".
Strengthen the system instructions with absolute keywords like "NEVER issue refunds unless the tier is Platinum".
Create a validation rule on the backend object to reject refund records created for non-Platinum accounts.
explanation: Para garantizar determinísticamente que una acción solo se ejecute bajo ciertas condiciones, se debe usar un filtro condicional de acción (Action Condition filter). Las instrucciones dadas al LLM son probabilísticas y pueden fallar.

question: Universal Containers wants to use an external large language model (LLM) in Prompt Builder. What should an AI Specialist recommend?
options: Use Apex to connect to an external LLM and ground the prompt.
Use BYO-LLM functionality in Einstein Studio,
Use Flow and External Services to bring data from an external LLM.
explanation: Para usar un LLM externo en Prompt Builder, se debe emplear la funcionalidad Bring Your Own LLM (BYO-LLM) en Einstein Studio Model Builder.

question: Universal Containers (UC) needs to save agents time with AI-generated case summaries. UC has implemented the Work Summary feature. What does Einstein consider when generating a summary?
options: Generation is grounded with conversation context, Knowledge articles, and cases.
Generation is grounded with existing conversation context only.
Generation is grounded with conversation context and Knowledge articles.
explanation: Einstein Work Summaries se basa en el contexto de la conversación, los artículos de Knowledge y los casos. Estos tres elementos fundamentan la generación de resúmenes precisos.

question: Northern Timber Co. is finalizing version 9 of a prompt template with significant updates from version 8. A pricing miscalculation is discovered in version 8 that requires an urgent hotfix in production. The finance team will deploy the fix as a new version. How can the specialist keep their work on version 9 safe while the hotfix is deployed?
options: Overwrite version 8 with the hotfix, then manually re-apply the version 9 changes on top of the corrected version 8.
Keep version 9 unchanged; the finance team should deploy the hotfix as version 10, preserving version 9 as is.
Pause work on version 9, apply the hotfix directly to version 9, and redeploy version 9 as the new production version.
explanation: Las versiones son independientes y coexisten sin sobreescribirse. Desplegar el hotfix como una versión nueva es la vía segura, dejando la versión 9 intacta.

question: An Agentforce wants to ground a new prompt template with the User related list. What should the Agentforce Specialist consider?
options: The User related list should have View All access.
The User related list needs to be included on the record page.
The User related list is not supported in prompt templates.
explanation: La lista relacionada del objeto User no está soportada para grounding en prompt templates debido a restricciones de seguridad.

question: Universal Containers implemented Agentforce for its users. One user complains that Agentforce is not deleting activities from the past 7 days. What is the reason for this issue?
options: Agentforce Delete Record Action permission is not associated to the user.
Agentforce does not have the permission to delete the user's records.
Agentforce does not support the Delete Record action.
explanation: Por motivos de seguridad, las acciones estándar de Agentforce no soportan la eliminación directa de registros.

question: BlueRidge Manufacturing wants to include live production order status in its AI prompt responses. The order data lives in an external MES (Manufacturing Execution System) and is surfaced in Salesforce via Salesforce Connect. What is the most appropriate data grounding technique to use in the prompt template?
options: Apex merge fields to write a custom method that retrieves the order data programmatically at prompt generation time.
External Services merge fields to invoke the MES API endpoint and inject the response into the prompt.
External Object Record merge fields to pull the live order status from the external MES system directly into the prompt template.
explanation: Se deben utilizar campos de combinación de registros (Record Merge Fields) para extraer información de External Objects expuestos vía Salesforce Connect. Así se integra el dato externo directamente al prompt de forma nativa.

question: A property management company's agent must check if a maintenance request is within warranty before dispatching a technician. The company wants to keep the conversation natural for tenants but ensure the warranty check always happens first. What should the specialist do?
options: Use procedural instructions in Agent Script to enforce the warranty check step before any technician dispatch action.
Move the warranty check logic into a separate agent and route all maintenance requests through that agent first.
Add a natural language instruction at the top of the subagent prompt saying "Always check warranty before dispatching."
explanation: Para garantizar que una verificación obligatoria ocurra antes de otra acción, deben usarse instrucciones de procedimiento (`->`). Estas se ejecutan de manera determinista, evitando que el LLM las omita.

question: A development team needs to understand the core components of a custom agent action to ensure proper configuration. What should they review in the custom action configuration to identify one of these core components?
options: Output types, which define returned data but aren't considered core to reasoning/selection.
Action triggers, which are optional rather than fundamental.
Instructions, which guide the reasoning engine on how and when to use the action.
explanation: Las Instrucciones (Instructions) son el componente central que guía al motor de razonamiento sobre cómo y cuándo usar una acción personalizada.

question: The marketing team at Universal Containers is looking for a way to personalize emails based on customer behavior, preferences, and purchase history. Why should the team use Agentforce as the solution?
options: To generate relevant content when engaging with each customer
To analyze past campaign performance
To send automated emails to all customers
explanation: Einstein Agentforce se utiliza para generar contenido altamente relevante y personalizado basándose en datos del cliente.

question: What should FinanceHub consider when deploying an AI Service Agent with multiple conversation topics and custom actions to their production environment?
options: Deploy all components simultaneously without staging validation.
Ensure all required dependencies are included, verify Apex code meets minimum test coverage requirements, and confirm configuration alignment with production settings before deployment.
Deploy custom actions and Apex logic first, then agent topics/configurations afterward.
explanation: Antes de desplegar a producción, es crucial incluir todas las dependencias, cumplir con la cobertura de pruebas de Apex y alinear la configuración. Desplegar todos los componentes interdependientes juntos evita funcionalidades incompletas.

question: Sunrise Bakery has detailed recipe documents where allergen warnings are often embedded inside larger ingredient sections. The agent must retrieve these allergen notes accurately, but the default chunking method splits them apart. Which chunking adjustment should the administrator make?
options: Decrease chunk size to individual words and use a phrase-matching algorithm at query time.
Increase chunk size so that entire ingredient sections, including embedded warnings, remain as whole chunks.
Switch to fixed-size character chunks with no overlap to ensure uniform chunk lengths.
explanation: El tamaño del chunk determina cuánto contexto se mantiene junto. Aumentar el tamaño ayuda a que secciones completas permanezcan en el mismo chunk, mejorando la recuperación.

question: A specialist is troubleshooting an agent that makes up fake product SKUs in its responses. The agent uses an action with a prompt template that includes a knowledge retriever. What is the most appropriate first step to diagnose the root cause?
options: Check the retrieved chunks in the resolved prompt output to see if the LLM is generating SKUs not present in the grounding data.
Add a system instruction that says "NEVER invent SKUs" in bold and re-test.
Verify that the subagent's classification description has a high confidence threshold.
explanation: Revisar los fragmentos recuperados en el prompt resuelto permite confirmar si las alucinaciones se deben a falta de contexto o a inventos del modelo.

question: Apex Voyages, a luxury cruise line operator, has deployed an agent to manage guest bookings, excursion reservations, and loyalty upgrades. The agent needs to respond naturally to guest inquiries but must always run a credit hold check before confirming any upgrade. The development team is evaluating instruction patterns. Which statement accurately describes hybrid reasoning in Agentforce Agent Script?
options: Hybrid reasoning depends on two separate language models running in parallel, with one dedicated to conversational tasks and the other to deterministic operations.
Hybrid reasoning mixes natural language instructions that the LLM interprets adaptively with prefixed commands that execute in an enforced, unchangeable order.
Hybrid reasoning requires storing all conversational logic in external CRM flows and all business rules in Apex triggers for proper separation.
explanation: El razonamiento híbrido en Agent Script combina instrucciones declarativas para la interacción natural con comandos de procedimiento deterministas. Todo esto se ejecuta dentro de un único modelo, sin necesidad de herramientas externas.

question: A travel agency wants to route incoming Facebook Messenger messages to an automated agent that can handle flight changes, hotel bookings, and cancellation requests. Which destination is a valid Omni-Channel routing option for a messaging channel?
options: External chatbot via custom API
Agentforce Service Agent
Legacy Einstein Bot
explanation: Agentforce Service Agent es un destino de enrutamiento oficial y nativo dentro de Omni-Channel para procesar interacciones desde canales de mensajería.

question: What is true of Agentforce Testing Center?
options: Running tests risks modifying CRM data in a production environment.
Running tests does not consume Einstein Requests.
Agentforce Testing Center can only be used in a production environment.
explanation: Probar en producción es riesgoso porque las acciones del agente (Flujos/Apex) pueden realizar operaciones DML y modificar datos reales del CRM, aunque no consuman Einstein Requests.

question: After deploying a new support assistant from development to production via change set, the team discovers that a critical approval flow invoked by the assistant fails with an error. The flow exists in production and was included in the change set. What is the most probable cause of this failure?
options: The flow was deployed in an inactive state and requires manual activation before it can be called by the assistant.
The change set omitted dependent Apex classes.
The assistant user lacks the Run Flows permission.
explanation: Al desplegar flujos mediante conjuntos de cambios (change sets), estos llegan inactivos por defecto a producción. Por lo tanto, deben ser activados manualmente antes de que el asistente pueda invocarlos.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to use Generative AI Salesforce functionality to reduce Service Agent handling time by providing recommended replies based on the existing Knowledge articles. On which AI capability should UC train the service agents?
options: Service Replies
Case Replies
Knowledge Replies
explanation: Knowledge Replies genera respuestas recomendadas basándose en artículos de Knowledge existentes para reducir significativamente el tiempo de manejo.

question: Universal Containers is evaluating Einstein Generative AI features to improve the productivity of the service center operation. Which features should the Agentforce Specialist recommend?
options: Service Replies and Case Summaries
Service Replies and Work Summaries
Reply Recommendations and Sales Summaries
explanation: Las Respuestas de servicio y los Resúmenes de casos asisten a los agentes generando respuestas sugeridas y resúmenes rápidos del caso. Esto reduce tiempos de respuesta y mejora la eficiencia del centro de servicio.

question: What is the primary function of the reasoning engine in Agentforce?
options: Generating record queries based on conversation history
Identifying agent topics and actions to respond to user utterances
Offering real-time natural language responses during conversations
explanation: El reasoning engine identifica topics y acciones adecuados para responder a la declaración (utterance) del usuario.

question: What is a key benefit of the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol?
options: Provides a standardized framework for cross-vendor agent discovery and communication
Allows auto-onboard third-party agents without additional contracts, trust scores, or shared identity controls
Provides a standardized runtime engine for internal agent discovery and communication
explanation: El protocolo Agent-to-Agent (A2A) permite que agentes de diferentes proveedores se descubran y comuniquen de forma segura. Esto facilita la interoperabilidad entre distintos ecosistemas de IA.

question: A data analyst needs permissions to view and manage AI models in Einstein Studio and also create prompt templates in Prompt Builder. Which permission sets should be assigned to the data analyst?
options: Prompt Template Manager and Prompt Template User.
Data Cloud Admin and Prompt Template Manager.
Einstein Studio User and Prompt Template Manager.
explanation: El conjunto de permisos 'Data Cloud Admin' (o Activation Specialist) otorga acceso a Einstein Studio junto con 'Prompt Template Manager' para plantillas.

question: Customer service agents at Precision Manufacturing report that the AI assistant frequently surfaces outdated technical documentation, even though updated versions exist in the knowledge base. The system administrator has verified that all documents are properly processed and indexed. What configuration change in the search index would most effectively resolve this issue?
options: Enable semantic search with boosted relevance scoring.
Add a freshness weighting factor based on document modification date to prioritize newer content.
Prioritize exact keyword matches over semantic similarity.
explanation: Agregar un factor de ponderación basado en la fecha de modificación garantiza que el contenido más reciente tenga mayor prioridad. Esto corrige el problema de recuperación de documentos obsoletos cuando la indexación ya es correcta.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is using standard Service AI Grounding. UC created a custom rich text field to be used with Service AI Grounding. What should UC consider when using standard Service AI Grounding?
options: Service AI Grounding only works with Case and Knowledge objects.
Service AI Grounding only supports String and Text Area type fields.
Service AI Grounding visibility works m system mode.
explanation: Service AI Grounding solo soporta campos de tipo Cadena y Área de texto, excluyendo campos de texto enriquecido personalizados.

question: Blue Harbor Marina is configuring a Data Library connected to Salesforce Knowledge. They need to select identifying fields to help the agent find relevant boat maintenance guides. The guides are long and detailed. What should they use as identifying fields?
options: The full guide text, as it contains all maintenance steps and safety warnings.
Short descriptive fields such as the guide title, a one-sentence summary, or keyword tags like "engine" or "hull."
Any rich text field that contains the guide's last inspection date or author name.
explanation: Los identifying fields deben ser metadatos concisos y buscables que ayuden a ubicar rápido el documento. El texto completo pertenece a los content fields, usados para fundamentar la respuesta.

question: What information becomes available to an Agentforce Specialist when the 'Enrich event logs with conversation data' setting is enabled?
options: Session data including complete user inputs and agent responses becomes available for interaction analysis.
Comprehensive reports across all conversations can be generated automatically by this setting alone.
User click paths leading to each agent action become visible.
explanation: Habilitar esta configuración hace que los datos de la sesión, incluyendo las entradas del usuario y las respuestas del agente, estén disponibles para su análisis.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to build an Agentforce Service Agent that provides the latest, active, and relevant policy and compliance information to customers. The agent must: ● Semantically search HR policies, compliance guidelines, and company procedures ● Ensure responses are grounded on published Knowledge ● Allow Knowledge updates to be reflected immediately without manual reconfiguration What should UC do to ensure the agent retrieves the right information?
options: Set up an Agentforce Data Library to store and index policy documents for AI retrieval.
Enable the agent to search all internal records and past customer inquiries.
Manually add policy responses into the AI model to prevent hallucinations.
explanation: La mejor práctica es configurar una Data Library indexada. Esto permite búsquedas semánticas precisas (grounding) y mantiene las políticas actualizadas en tiempo real.
